cells.Read by: `dice`, `slice` and the wrappers (`bin/dice`, `bin/slice`, `bin/rinzler` and other files)
cells.Set by: The test fixtures of Dice and Slice.
cells.Values and default: Exactly `1` allows the override. Any other text does not. Unset: a set `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is an error in `bin/dice`, `bin/slice` and the wrappers. The error contains `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH is test-only`.
cells.Effect: Gives the permission that `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` needs. That variable replaces `/etc/positron/dice.yaml` (the Dice host configuration file) with a test file. rows.name: DICE_RUNTIME_DIR

problems.statement: On a shared host, `bin/dice` stops with `DICE_RUNTIME_DIR is test-only in shared Dice`, unless the test override `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is active.
problems.code_says: The test runs only inside runtime_dir(). On a shared host without the override, a client command of bin/dice never calls it: socket_path() returns the configured socket, and ensure_daemon() returns before ensure_runtime_dir(). So 'dice submit', 'dice queue' and 'dice cancel' ignore the variable. Only the daemon stops at startup. bin/slice stops too: dice_state_snapshot() calls state_path() of the bin/dice module, which calls runtime_dir(), and main() prints 'error: DICE_RUNTIME_DIR is test-only in shared Dice; ...'.

problems.statement: on a shared host (`mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`)
problems.code_says: The fact holds. The clause defines 'shared host', which the document defines once in 'Words used here'.

cells.Values and default: Path of a directory. The text is used as given. Unset: on a shared host, the directory of the configured socket, `/run/dice` by default. Otherwise `/tmp/dice-<user name>`.
cells.Effect: Moves the Dice runtime directory. The directory holds the state file, the daemon log, the lock files, the `logs` directory and the `launch` directory. On a shared host the socket keeps its configured path. Only tests can use it. On a shared host outside a `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` override, a daemon with this variable does not start. It prints `DICE_RUNTIME_DIR is test-only in shared Dice`. A `bin/slice` command that reads the state file stops with the same error text. A client command of `bin/dice` ignores the variable there. Without that override, the daemon removes the variable from the environment of programs it starts. On a legacy host no Dice daemon runs.

rows.name: DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH

problems.statement: a pytest command among the process and its 5 nearest ancestors
problems.code_says: _cmdline_is_pytest() accepts only three forms: an argument -m followed by pytest; an argument --from followed by pytest, with a later argument pytest; or a first argument whose file name is pytest and whose path contains /.cache/uv/. A pytest program that is started directly from another place is refused with 'DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH is test-only and is disabled outside pytest'. The count of the process plus 5 ancestors is right.

problems.statement: With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, it also needs `DICE_ALLOW_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_SHADOW_SHARED=1`.
problems.code_says: The fact holds. The sentence spells out the definition of 'shared host', which the document defines once in 'Words used here'.
